summary: Important: kernel security, bug fix, and enhancement update
details:
The kernel packages contain the Linux kernel, the core of any Linux operating system.

Security Fix(es):

* kernel: Kernel: Denial of Service in network socket error handling (CVE-2026-22977)

* kernel: x86/CPU/AMD: Prevent improper isolation of shared resources in Zen2's op cache (CVE-2026-46174)

* kernel: i2c: stub: Reject I2C block transfers with invalid length (CVE-2026-64191)

* kernel: Linux kernel: PPP over L2TP Use-After-Free vulnerability (CVE-2026-68398)

* kernel: mptcp: pm: userspace: fix use-after-free in get_local_id (CVE-2026-68169)

* kernel: tipc: require net admin for TIPCv2 netlink mutators (CVE-2026-74283)

* kernel: mptcp: options: reset DSS fields in case of unexpected size (CVE-2026-80586)

* kernel: entry: Fix seccomp bypass after ptrace with TSYNC (CVE-2026-89603)

* kernel: KVM: nVMX: Always flush vpid02 on first use (CVE-2026-89932)

* kernel: scsi: target: iscsi: Reserve a terminator byte for the login payload (CVE-2026-90011)

* kernel: virtio-fs: avoid double-free on failed queue setup (CVE-2026-93827)

* kernel: smb: client: bound dirent name against end of SMB response in cifs_filldir (CVE-2026-93787)

* kernel: KEYS: encrypted: fix integer overflow of datablob_len (CVE-2026-98222)

* kernel: xfrm: hold net_device reference under RCU in bundle creation (CVE-2026-98364)

* kernel: ipv4: free inet_opt and ireq_opt after an RCU grace period (CVE-2026-98432)

* kernel: nvmet-auth: fix out-of-bounds write in nvmet_auth_challenge() (CVE-2026-98725)

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

* ipv4: ip_gre: make ipgre_header() robust (rhel-10.2.z) (JIRA:Rocky Linux-270702)

* ip6_gre: make ip6gre_header() robust (rhel-10.2.z) (JIRA:Rocky Linux-270721)

* Rocky Linux is missing support for conntrack zone filtering in dump/delete requests (10.4) [rhel-10.2.z] (JIRA:Rocky Linux-291348)

For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.
